about_the_game:
A single-player card game about killing gods. Through proper channels.

You are a reaper. Employed, salaried, and fully compliant under The Authority - a bureaucratic force responsible for the administration of death. Your job used to be simple: collect mortal souls, file the paperwork, move on.

Then came the recall order.

The gods - previously marked as exempt - are now to be processed. Unfortunately, an ancient clause prevents direct intervention. Immortality must be surrendered willingly, through loss in a sanctioned contest.

They chose a card game.
You were assigned to play it.
Try not to make mistakes.

FEATURES

  • Over 80 player cards for you to theorycraft and deckbuild with, with more coming.

  • Mortis: a resource drawn directly from your own soul. Use it wisely.

  • AI-driven bosses constructed from adjective + domain traits (e.g. Roaring Dreams, Hateful Fire)

  • Status effects like Banished, Fogged, and Entombed - each with lasting consequences

  • Codex paths offer an alternate route to victory - or at least to survival

  • Decks themed around roles within The Authority: Auditor, Archivist, Enforcer, and worse

THIS DEMO INCLUDES

  • Bounty mode, where you can fight scripted bosses of legend!

  • Fully playable core loop

  • Deckbuilding and preset decks

  • Status systems and balance pass

  • Procedural boss logic and reactive dialogue

  • Placeholder visuals. Final Notice is an evolving process.

YOUR FEEDBACK MATTERS

Final Notice is under active development. Submissions are reviewed. Suggestions are logged. Non-compliance is… noted.

Wishlist on Steam to remain in good standing.
